data.name: Laithi
data.gender_notes: Laithi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Laithi is derived from the Arabic word 'Layth', meaning lion, symbolizing bravery and strength. It is a name associated with courage and valor. The name Laithi carries the meaning “Lion or Brave one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Laithi usually hope their child will grow to embody lion or brave one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, the name Laithi signifies a person who is strong in faith and courageous in the face of adversity, much like the characteristics associated with a lion.
data.etymology: Laithi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion or Brave one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Laithi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: لايثي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم لؤلؤة الماء، يعني الماء المعدني
